lastCompletedStory.title: Anchor implementer dispatch to issue-bound PRD in both orchestrator personas

nextStoryContext: US-001 through US-004 are complete. The runtime and template hook copies have the capability+scope model (US-001/US-002). The recovery-runbook section (q) documents the new policy (US-003). Both orchestrator personas now include a dispatch pre-flight rule refusing /cam-next when prd.json has no non-null issueNumber (US-004). The two persona copies are byte-identical and src/vendor/_generated.ts is up to date. No further stories with passes:false remain in the PRD.
